summary: Kimi Antonelli drove through the field from 19th on the grid to score a stunning Mercedes victory in an incident-packed Italian Grand Prix at Monza. The race unfolded in chaos, with multiple collisions reshaping the order and leaving Ferrari's title hopes further damaged as the Scuderia failed to capitalize on their home race. Antonelli's breakthrough win tightens Mercedes' grip on the constructors' championship while elevating the young driver into contention for future title runs.
